evidence: Directly alters block and undo file storage in src/node/blockstorage.cpp (+189/-26) and src/node/blockstorage.h.
rationale: Adds a crash-safe `-reobfuscate-blocks` command to rewrite block and undo files with custom or random XOR keys without resyncing. As the description notes, nodes synced before v28 have no built-in way to obfuscate existing files, rotate keys, or remove obfuscation without redownloading the entire chain from scratch, providing clear operational utility while remaining reasonably deferrable.
